name: Sourabh Gupta
player_statement:
A complete player, Sourabh Gupta has made a big mark in cricket. With 12 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 38, with an average of 15.45 and a quick strike rate of 125.00. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 21 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 5.5 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 12.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
